extreme macro close-up, 100mm lens, single brick studs the size of dinner plates, background dissolving into creamy bokeh — every plastic detail of one focal element fills the frame
tilt-shift miniature effect, narrow focus band running diagonally, foreground and background dissolving into dreamy soft gradients — exaggerates the toy-photography feel
wide establishing diorama shot, 24mm lens, deep focus from front to back, every brick sharp edge-to-edge, the entire build visible in frame
eye-level minifig POV — camera at minifig-shoulder height, treating the build as if you're standing inside the world
top-down 90-degree overhead, perfectly orthographic — the whole baseplate visible, build read as map / blueprint
high-angle bird's-eye view at 60 degrees, looking down across the diorama, foreground build elements towering in lower frame
low-hero up-shot, looking up from baseplate level, the build looms heroic against backdrop, 24mm wide-angle distortion exaggerating scale
dutch-angle 15-degree tilt, off-balance composition, dynamic motion implied even in a static scene
over-the-shoulder of a hero minifig — minifig back-and-shoulder filling lower-left third, scene visible past it
extreme worm's-eye view, camera lying on the baseplate, looking straight up at towering builds and sky
fisheye 12mm wide-angle distortion — curved horizon, exaggerated foreground, edges of frame warping
cinematic 2.39:1 widescreen letterbox composition, 35mm anamorphic lens flares, horizontal lens-streak highlights
through-the-archway / framed-window composition — peering through a brick archway / window / portcullis at the action beyond, frame-within-frame
POV first-person minifig — exactly what the protagonist minifig is seeing, foreground hands / weapons visible
vehicle-tracking shot — camera moving parallel to a moving vehicle (train, ship, mech), motion blur on background
deep-focus dolly push-in, foreground build / minifig sharp, mid and far receding into atmospheric perspective
reflection composition — main scene visible only as reflection in transparent water / mirror / chrome surface, real scene partial in background
silhouette / backlit — main subject in pure dark silhouette against bright backlit sky / window / explosion
rule-of-thirds, hero element on a power point, leading lines drawing eye through frame
low-key chiaroscuro, single hard key light, deep absolute black shadows carving the build out of darkness
smoke-wreathed atmospheric — main build emerging through dramatic volumetric haze, light rays cutting through
rim-light from behind, edge of every brick gilded, body of build in shadow
extreme telephoto 200mm compressed-perspective — distant background flattened against foreground, scale ambiguous
Wes-Anderson-style centered symmetric tableau, single-point perspective dead-center, deliberate flatness
diorama side-elevation, perfectly profile, shot like an architectural drawing rendered in plastic
behind-the-builder over-the-shoulder, builder's hand JUST out of frame (no skin shown), build fills the frame
extreme aerial / drone-overhead, looking down from very high — the build is one of many on a vast tabletop, edges of other builds visible
cross-section cutaway — building / ship / vehicle sliced open showing interiors layered on multiple floors
puddle reflection low-angle — main scene visible in water reflection in foreground baseplate puddle, real scene above
shadow-puppet — only the minifig silhouettes are visible cast on a brick wall, the figures themselves out of frame
ground-level long-lens — camera resting on baseplate at eye-of-bug height, blade of grass / brick foliage in immediate foreground
diagonal split composition — frame divided diagonally between two contrasting build elements, dynamic tension
centered single-subject hero shot, minimal background, shallow DOF — one bloom, one minifig, one build piece dominates
interior establishing shot — wide-angle inside a brick-built interior space, ceiling and four walls visible at once
vehicle-cabin POV — through windshield of cockpit / dashboard / wheelhouse, instruments and view-out visible in frame
looking-down-from-balcony — camera at upper-tier railing pointing down, action unfolding in atrium below
approach-shot — camera moving toward the scene, foreground build receding fast, back-of-build flying past
establishing wide / cut-to-detail diptych framing — two-panel feel, broad context dominating one half, intimate detail the other
macro detail of a single mechanical element — gear, lever, hinge, latch, transparent piece — context defocused
panorama spliced wide aspect — extreme horizontal stretch, multiple subjects across the breadth of the frame
